newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel steady against dollar and basket.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel steady against dollar and basket.

text.p: The Israeli shekel representative rate was fixed almost unchanged against the dollar and the basket of currencies Tuesday in thin trading, dealers said.

"Trading was very quiet today and volume was low. Despite that, the Bank of Israel had to intervene in the market, buying dollars, to support the basket which fell below the lower edge of the trading band," said Gideon Sadeh of Bank Leumi.
He estimated that the central bank purchased $70 million.
The central bank has been intervening regularly in the market to support the currency basket, which has been trading at the bottom end of its trading band for four months.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.4070 shekels, against 3.4060 on Monday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.6985 against 3.6980 Monday.
On the crosses, the shekel traded against the yen at 2.9413 shekels per 100 yen compared with 2.9259 on Monday, and against the mark at 1.9758 shekels compared with 1.9794 on Monday.
In the late afternoon, the dollar was trading at 3.4070 shekels.
- Dan Gerstenfeld, Tel Aviv newsroom, 972-3-537-2211 x233
